curiosities: NEC's PC-98 series dominated Japanese personal computers through the 1980s and early 1990s.
Its architecture differs from the IBM PC's, so DOS software for one does not run on the other.
The first five Touhou Project games were released on it.
It shows kanji text directly, from a font stored in ROM.
The first model used an Intel 8086 at 5 MHz.
Windows 95 had a version of its own for it.
